newsitem.title: USA: Ambassador Apartments closes bond financing.
newsitem.headline: Ambassador Apartments closes bond financing.

text.p: Ambassador Apartments Inc said it closed three bond financings totalling $21.59 million.
The company said on April 17, it closed on the refinancing of the $8.54 million of tax exempt bonds encumbering the Crossings of Bellevue project in Nashville, Tenn.
The refinancing allowed Ambassador to reduce all-in interest costs, it said.
On April 24, Ambassador said it closed on the issuance of new bonds totalling $13.05 million by the Harris County Housing Finance Corp.
Proceeds from the Harris County bond issues were partly used to repay outstanding bank debt, Ambassador said.
